|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Leia Of Alderaan (V)]] (version 2 of 3). The image here is the Players Committee card image ([[:File:V5-L-Leia_Of_Alderaan_(V)-2020-05-12-a5142dd.gif]]). The current text is [[Leia Of Alderaan (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; bracketed names such as [Episode VII] stand for icons printed on the cards, and ▲ is the card's icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[Leia Of Alderaan (V)]]): Virtual Set 5 release ([[Virtual Set 5]]); Players Committee card image<ref name="ht0">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/leiaofalderaan.gif leiaofalderaan.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit 022435b "Set 9 load", 8 July 2018.</ref>. Margin “•Leia Of Alderaan”: “Deploy on a Rebel leader. Opponent may not cancel or reduce Force drains at same battleground. If on Leia, she is a general, power +2, and, once per turn, may cancel the immunity to attrition of a character (or game text of a [Jabba's Palace] alien) here for remainder of turn.” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Players Committee card image, marked “E”<ref name="ht1">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/leiaofalderaan.gif leiaofalderaan.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit a5142dd "Tweak set images", 12 May 2020.</ref>: “Deploy on Leia (or your female of ability < 4). Opponent may not cancel or reduce Force drains at same battleground. If on Leia, she is power +2 and, once per battle, may cancel the game text of an opponent's leader of ability < 4 here.” '''What changed:''' “Deploy on a Rebel leader.” became “Deploy on Leia (or your female of ability &lt; 4).”, and the Leia clause became “she is power +2 and, once per battle, may cancel the game text of an opponent's leader of ability &lt; 4 here” (no longer a general; no longer cancels immunity to attrition or an alien's game text); the margin lost its dot. No errata sheet for this change has been found; the commit date, 12 May 2020, is the earliest proven date. Before/after: [[File:V5-L-Leia_Of_Alderaan_(V)-compare-022435b-a5142dd.png|440px]]
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Leia Of Alderaan (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image, marked “E1”<ref name="ht2">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/53572eb94d14c4f21f0f3396874727653397c6e8/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/leiaofalderaan.gif leiaofalderaan.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit 53572eb "Fixing case and making gifs", 16 August 2023.</ref>: “Deploy on Leia (or your female of ability < 4). Opponent may not cancel or reduce Force drains at same battleground. If on Leia, she is power +2 and, once per battle, may cancel the game text of an opponent's leader of ability < 4 here.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same; the card was re-rendered at higher resolution, the errata mark became “E1” and the line breaks moved. A version because the change is visible on the card (Bill, 12 November 2026). The card prints the errata mark “E1” although this is change 2 in release order: a PC transcription error in the mark (Bill, 12 November 2026: number versions by release order and record the printed mark). This is the current text. Before/after: [[File:V5-L-Leia_Of_Alderaan_(V)-compare-a5142dd-53572eb.png|440px]]
